subskills.label: Construct a bounded sampling and data-collection plan
subskills.capability_statement: Given a bounded measurement objective and operating context, select a sampling and data-collection approach, state the population or process boundary, identify collection controls and limitations, and distinguish planned evidence from observations not yet collected.

subskills.label: Evaluate descriptive statistics
subskills.capability_statement: Given a bounded dataset and stated measurement context, compute or interpret appropriate descriptive summaries, identify distortion or coverage limits, and avoid extending descriptive results into unsupported causal or population claims.

subskills.label: Construct an appropriate graphical representation
subskills.capability_statement: Given bounded data and an explicit analytical question, select and construct an appropriate graphical method, state what pattern the display supports, and identify misleading or unsupported interpretations.

subskills.label: Evaluate a measurement system
subskills.capability_statement: Given bounded measurement-system evidence and stated use requirements, evaluate whether observed measurement variation or bias is material to the intended decision and identify evidence still required before stronger suitability claims.

subskills.label: Compare process performance with specifications
subskills.capability_statement: Given bounded process-performance evidence and explicit specification limits, compare observed performance with the specification basis and distinguish descriptive conformance evidence from unobserved future capability or effectiveness.

decomposition_edges.rationale: Make sampling and data-collection planning assessable while keeping actual observations and approvals external until observed.
Expose descriptive-statistics evaluation as a bounded capability without implying causal or population authority.
Make graphical-method construction assessable while requiring an explicit data question and preserving interpretation limits.
Make MSA evaluation independently assessable while preserving real measurement observations and acceptance authority as separate evidence.
Expose performance/specification comparison as assessable without converting observed comparison into unobserved long-term capability or effectiveness claims.

unresolved_dependency_candidates.reason: Data type and scale knowledge may constrain sampling and collection choices, but the frozen source alone does not establish a mandatory dependency.
Collected data precede descriptive analysis operationally, but stronger semantic evidence is required before a canonical curriculum prerequisite is admitted.
Descriptive summaries and graphical methods are related, but their instructional dependency direction is not established by the source title or order.
Measurement-system adequacy can affect confidence in performance comparisons, but this relationship remains provisional without richer semantic or SME evidence.
